what: From the spot where the pointer enters, a circle 2.25× the element width grows from 0, fills the background and flips the text. When the pointer leaves, the circle shrinks toward the spot it exits. Duration is aspect ratio × .08s, clamped to .27~.42s (longer for longer buttons), with cubic-bezier(.4,.05,.3,1). The Keep type leaves the text color alone and applies only a light fill (link box).

options.--fx-fill: Circle color (set via style), default var(--kf-accent)
options.--fx-on: Text color after painting, default var(--kf-on-accent)
options.--fx-size: Circle diameter (relative to element width), default 225%
options.look: keep — text color stays as is and only the circle is filled (light-fill link box)

from.where: shared.css [data-hover=coordinate]·[data-hover=button] (header menu · request materials · contact · member button · menu button · view-all button), about.css .ab-card (pale lime fill — look: keep), shared.css .m-next a
